description: The Marut airframe fitted with the Brandner E-300 engine and flown in Egypt during the joint Indian-Egyptian engine programme of the late 1960s. Displayed at the Helwan aircraft complex where the E-300 was built. No serial recorded by any source consulted. This is the only HF-24 outside India.
Second airframe at the same Helwan display point alongside the HF-24. No serial recorded. Helwan built the type under licence as the Al Kahira so this example is probably Egyptian-built.
